claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Galantamine is a reversible acetylcholinesterase inhibitor with additional nicotinic allosteric modulation; at 2.5 uM over 5 days it is not expected to produce meaningful cytotoxicity in a pooled cancer cell line viability screen.
